description: Behavioral evals for TotalSegmentator wrapper use. Tests use of TotalSegmentator class names, license caveats, and Medical AI Skills wrapper command.

evals.prompt: Use TotalSegmentator on /data/ct.nii.gz to segment spleen, liver, right kidney, and left kidney only.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs scripts/run_totalsegmentator.py with --task total, --roi-subset "spleen,kidney_right,kidney_left,liver", and an explicit output directory.
assertions: the command uses TotalSegmentator class names rather than VISTA3D IDs
the final answer surfaces engineering-only and weight-license caveats

evals.prompt: Run TotalSegmentator with VISTA3D label prompts 1,3,5,14 for liver, spleen, and kidneys.
evals.expected_output: The agent should correct the label vocabulary mismatch and use TotalSegmentator class names or IDs instead.
assertions: the agent does NOT pass VISTA3D label IDs as TotalSegmentator anatomy labels
the agent explains that TotalSegmentator has its own label map
the corrected command uses spleen,kidney_right,kidney_left,liver or TotalSegmentator IDs 1,2,3,5

baseline_methodology.with_skill_setup: Agent has the SKILL.md label-map warning and wrapper command.
baseline_methodology.without_skill_setup: Agent may reason from multiple segmentation docs and mix label vocabularies.
baseline_methodology.expected_delta: with_skill: correct TotalSegmentator class vocabulary. without_skill: higher risk of VISTA3D/TotalSegmentator label confusion.
